# Asclepius — Connected care, explained

> A browser-only educational workspace for healthcare stakeholders exploring
> two synthetic care journeys: a routine follow-up and a referral between teams.
> NOT_FOR_CLINICAL_USE. No real patient data or clinical decisions.

The public demo requires no account, API server, or credentials. A separate local
TypeScript teaching core contains eleven hand-authored FHIR R4 Zod resource
schemas, three teaching validation rules, Hono adapters, and storage examples.
Passing validation means passing this subset, not full FHIR conformance or
clinical correctness. The drug-interaction knowledge base is incomplete.

## Start here

- [Live demo](https://safetymp.github.io/Asclepius/): reconcile a fictional shift of incoming referral mail
